coverage.description: Static extraction of documented and observed ComfyUI frontend extension hooks.
deferred: hooks referenced without nearby typed declarations

hooks.name: addCustomNodeDefs
hooks.description: Called before nodes are registered with the graph

hooks.name: afterConfigureGraph
hooks.description: Allows the extension to run code after the graph is configured.

hooks.name: beforeConfigureGraph
hooks.description: Allows the extension to modify the graph data before it is configured.

hooks.name: beforeRegisterNodeDef
hooks.description: Allows the extension to add additional handling to the node before it is registered with **LGraph**

hooks.name: beforeRegisterVueAppNodeDefs
hooks.description: Allows the extension to modify the node definitions before they are used in the Vue app Modifications is expected to be made in place.

hooks.name: getCanvasMenuItems
hooks.description: Allows the extension to add context menu items to canvas right-click menus

hooks.name: getCustomWidgets
hooks.description: Allows the extension to add custom widgets

hooks.name: getNodeMenuItems
hooks.description: Allows the extension to add context menu items to node right-click menus

hooks.name: getSelectionToolboxCommands
hooks.description: Allows the extension to add additional commands to the selection toolbox

hooks.name: init
hooks.description: Allows any initialisation, e.g. loading resources. Called after the canvas is created but before nodes are added

hooks.name: loadedGraphNode
hooks.description: Allows the extension to modify a node that has been reloaded onto the graph. If you break something in the backend and want to patch workflows in the frontend This is the place to do this

hooks.name: nodeCreated
hooks.description: Allows the extension to run code after the constructor of the node

hooks.name: onAuthTokenRefreshed
hooks.description: Fired whenever the auth token is refreshed. This is an experimental API and may be changed or removed in the future.

hooks.name: onAuthUserLogout
hooks.description: Fired when user logs out. This is an experimental API and may be changed or removed in the future.

hooks.name: onAuthUserResolved
hooks.description: Fired whenever authentication resolves, providing the anonymized user id.. Extensions can register at any time and will receive the latest value immediately. This is an experimental API and may be changed or removed in the future.

hooks.name: registerCustomNodes
hooks.description: Allows the extension to register additional nodes with LGraph after standard nodes are added. Custom node classes should extend **LGraphNode**.

hooks.name: setup
hooks.description: Allows any additional setup, called after the application is fully set up and running
